commit_message: Implement ADR0143 model resource controls on current main
pr_title: GameEngine: implement ADR 0143 model resource controls
pr_body:
## Summary

Implements ADR 0143 Native ModelBackend Resource Controls and Hardware Telemetry on current main. Adds truthful Ollama-compatible resource capabilities and measured model telemetry, verified unload/offload/reload transitions, Interrupt-for-Editing and managed Play resource sequencing, Resume reload after authoritative-state inspection, and AI Studio resource visibility.

This current-main branch supersedes the earlier stale ADR0143 branch/PR after main advanced during validation.

## Validation

Windows Validation (affected) and Visual Validation for AI Studio are required before completion.
